data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 were GBP 965.311m. Using the syndicate's gross claims development table (2016-2018), prior year development calculated for older underwriting years (excluding the two most recent years) shows a net adverse movement of GBP 8.358m (a strengthening of reserves). This result reflects a mix of favourable development in some older years (e.g. 2016) and adverse development in others (notably 2017). The 2018 Reinsurance to Close (RITC) noted in the technical provisions materially affects the reserves and distorts development comparators; therefore the triangle-based PYD should be treated with caution.
raw_causal_phrases: unforeseen loss trends resulting from court rulings, changes in the law, differences in loss adjustment practice, medical and long-term care, and economic factors such as inflation can have a considerable impact on run-off results.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) gross figure not explicitly stated as a single 'movement in prior year provision' gross amount. PYD calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 28) per instructions (exclude two most recent underwriting years). The triangle and movements are distorted by a large 2018 Reinsurance to Close (RITC) item noted in the technical provisions; this reduces confidence in triangle-derived PYD.
